sources.quote: 8.7.1.1 A temporary deviation is requested through the supplier portal and needs approval before shipment.
BOM-LINE 120: part BR-220 (drawing Rev C); program STL-Torino-27; customer STL; material EN AW-6082-T6; features: 4 fastener holes
Annex A: programs STL-Torino-27 and STL-Torino-31.

findings.why: BR-220 belongs to program STL-Torino-27, which is covered by the Stellantis CSR. A temporary deviation needs Stellantis approval through the supplier portal before any shipment. No approval is in the documents, and DEV-2025-019 covers only HS-040. The request is within PRC-DEV-007 limits (1,800 pieces is at most 2000; 5 weeks is at most 6 weeks; 100% fastener hole inspection is included), and it stays with the approved source Alluminio B (AP-0311). So only the customer approval is open.
